resources.string: Each card measures an automation session, including maintenance windows. The battery figure is the change in Android’s reported battery percentage; it is not energy consumed or battery saved. A zero reading does not mean zero consumption. Charging, a rising level, or unavailable readings prevent a reliable comparison. Open Screen-off evidence to inspect saved Android state readings.
Clear all session history and saved Doze and sensor evidence? This cannot be undone.
History recording is disabled in Settings.
